comments.author: adudewithbadaim
comments.body_html:
after installing the mod into your SPT folder like most other mods do this

open the PTT folder and inside there’s a folder called configs and one called config. open the config folder and copy the SCC folder and paste it into the configs folder

then highlight the SCC folder to select and copy the text ‘SCC’

now open the UserConfig file and paste ‘SCC’ in the selected config field.

save the file and enjoy.

or

you can delete the configs folder and rename the config folder to configs. either way will work.
